verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a documented public API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing portals (Gateway with OHID sign-in, OH|TAX online filing, guides and tips), with no API reference, developer portal, or programmatic access documented. Probes of ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt, so no API surface was found there either.
